title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 18: Legacy

scenes.say: He starts asking a bigger question. What do I leave behind?
scenes.visual: a man standing at a window looking out over a city at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Not money. Not stuff. A blueprint.
scenes.visual: blueprint paper rolled out on a desk with a pencil, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He builds a business from a laptop and a vision.
scenes.visual: a laptop open on a kitchen table late at night, a notebook beside it, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: No investors. No team. Just discipline he learned at Fort Jackson.
scenes.visual: a man working at a desk at 5am, coffee steaming, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Every product he builds carries the same message.
scenes.visual: a black t-shirt with gold lettering folded on a table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
gold letters glowing on a dark wall, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He hires kids from the neighborhood to help.
scenes.visual: young people working on laptops in a small office, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Paychecks instead of packs. Skills instead of sentences.
scenes.visual: a young person receiving an envelope with a handshake, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Legacy is a ladder you leave down for somebody else.
scenes.visual: a ladder leaning against a brick wall toward a bright sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He's building the block he wished he grew up on.
scenes.visual: a clean Newark street with kids playing, golden afternoon light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Nineteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a key turning in a storefront lock at sunrise, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 18 of 25: Legacy. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
